description: Explain why DDS readers and writers on a topic do not talk, and who will. Pairs every reader with every writer per topic and returns a `MismatchScan`: `summary` (one line, read it first), `matched` (pairs DDS will connect given the announced QoS; data flow is not observed), `reports` (incompatible or risky QoS pairs, with participant names, requested vs offered values and the failed rule in `details`), `not_matched` (pairs DDS never matches: different partitions or type names; the QoS rules are NOT evaluated for them, and `latent_incompatible_policies` lists what would also break once fixed), `hints` (probable typos in orphan topic names, type id notes), plus `pairs_checked`, `topics_scanned`, `policies_checked` and `policies_unchecked`. Checked: Partition (`*` and `?` wildcards), type name, Reliability, Durability, Deadline, Liveliness, LatencyBudget, Ownership, DestinationOrder, DataRepresentation, History (risky only, where announced). **An empty `reports` with a non-empty `not_matched` still means no data flows**, and an all-empty result does not prove the bus healthy: discovery shows the QoS DECLARED, not runtime behavior (a 'deadline missed' log with compatible QoS means the writer's real period exceeds the deadline, which TopicForge cannot see). Pass `topic` to scope the scan. The lists are capped at 200 each (`truncated`; `*_total` keep the counts). A `late_joiner` match is a VOLATILE writer whose reader joined later on the same host: normal. Reports and partition splits carry `suggested_fixes`: text for a human, never applied by TopicForge; `verify_with` names the call that confirms the repair. **Read-only by architecture**. **Raises an MCP error** when no DDS module is active; mock returns fixtures. **Duration**: DDS binding behind the DDS lock, one call at a time; ends within 45 s; `busy` error if the lock is held (retry).

topic.description: Optional DDS topic to scope the scan to: `scan` or `rt/scan`. Omit to scan all topics.

name: detect_qos_mismatches

late_joiner.description: True for a VOLATILE writer whose reader joined over 1 s later on the same host: earlier samples are not delivered. Normal.

details.description: Requested and offered value and the failed rule, per policy.

incompatible_policies.description: Blocking or risky policies; values in `details`.

suggested_fixes.description: Fixes as text for a human to apply, never applied; empty when none.

unchecked.description: Policies not compared because one side announced no value.

detail.description: The two partition lists or the two type names.

latent_incompatible_policies.description: RxO policies that would ALSO be incompatible once the partition or type is fixed (shape of `MismatchReport.details`).

reason.description: `partition` (none in common) or `type_name` (different types); QoS rules are not evaluated.

suggested_fixes.description: Fixes proposed as text for a human to apply; TopicForge never applies them. Only for a `partition` split, and only on the first pair of identical splits on a topic. Empty when it proposes none for this finding.

requested.description: What the reader requests, e.g. `"RELIABLE"`, `"100 ms"`.

rule.description: The compatibility rule that failed, one sentence.

kind.description: Form of `text`: a CLI command, a ROS 2 QoS override, a DDS profile or a launch parameter.

target.description: Which node or side to change, writer or reader.

text.description: The exact command, YAML or XML to apply.

tradeoff.description: What is lost by applying it.

verify_with.description: The TopicForge tool to run again to confirm the repair.

outputSchema.description: Result of `detect_qos_mismatches`: findings plus what was and was not checked.

hints.description: Leads that are not findings: probable typos, type id notes, incomplete checks.

matched.description: Pairs DDS will connect given the announced QoS (data flow is not observed).

matched_total.description: Matched pairs before the size cap.

not_matched.description: Pairs DDS never matches (partition or type name). Non-empty with empty `reports` is NOT all-clear: no data flows between them.

not_matched_total.description: Not-matched pairs before the size cap.

policies_unchecked.description: What the scan does not cover, each with a reason; a clean result says nothing about them.

reports.description: Pairs sharing partition and type with incompatible or risky QoS.

summary.description: One-line reading of the scan: counts of incompatible, not matched and matched pairs.

topics_scanned.description: Topics that had at least one endpoint in scope.

truncated.description: True when `reports`, `matched` or `not_matched` hit the 200-entry cap (see `*_total`); narrow with `topic`.

outputSchema.title: MismatchScan

title: Detect QoS mismatches
